# High School DxD New Test Fixtures

Real ffprobe dumps from the [Judas] release of High School DxD New (Season 2).

## Track Structure

- **Audio 1**: Japanese Stereo (correctly labeled `jpn`)
- **Audio 2**: English Stereo (correctly labeled `eng`)
- **Subtitle 1**: English (Full) - ASS format
- **Subtitle 2**: English (Signs/Songs) - PGS format

## Notes

- Unlike other seasons, this release has correct language metadata
- Japanese audio is properly tagged as `jpn`
- No title-based language detection needed

## Expected Options

1. English audio (no subtitles)
2. Japanese audio + English subtitles
